Momin who has helped to translate this prayer book from English and to Mrs Prabinbala Momin Das for kindly revising the translation.
I am also very thankful to Mr.
Donald N.
Sangma for typing & proof reading this manuscript for printing.
Ingty.
Price Rs.

2/- --- Page 5 --- *"AERODENE"'MALKI, SHILLONG-793003 Phone: 3750 In mamory of my dear wife MRS INDIRA THEODORA INGTY who along with her friends and others have translated this prayer book into the Garo language.
--- Page 6 --- Ja'pang Kattarang Jak Pringo (Gilja Ka'ani) Olakiani 1.
Atamo (Gilja Ka'ani) Qlakiani 3.
Gitelni Meatamko Maniani 12 4.
Bi'sarangko Napbolatani Niam 27 5.
Dal'giminrangko Napbclatani Niam 35 6.
Jak Dondape Patiani (Confirmation) 44 7.
Bia Ka'atani Niam 48 8.
Sigiminko Gopani Niam 57 Nokna Patiani (Nokdonggaani) 63 10.
Bi'sana Mi Du'chengani 66 11, Bia Ka'na Tik Ka'ani 68 12.
Chiko Rongtalatna Bi'ani 72 13.
Gilja Nokko Nokdonggaani 75 14.

Bi'sa Atchiahina Mitelani 78 --- Page 7 --- I Pringo (Olakiani) Biani (Pamong ba gilja ka'dilgipa' ka'mao segimin Sastroni bakko poraie giljako a'bachenggen.) "Anga chakate an'tang Paaona re'ange una ingen, O, apa.
anga salgina, aro nang'ni nikanio papko dakaha, nang'ni depante mingkuna nitoja." (Luke 15:18, 19.) PAP KU·RACHAKAN!
Pamong :-Hai an'ching gisik nange, Isolni mikkango an chingni paprangko ku'rachakna.
Jinma : --Bilaksr:nggipa Isol, Pagipa, Degipa aro Gi- sik Rongtalgipao chinga ku'rachakenga, chong'motan chanchiao, aganao aro kamo chinga jrimgipa dosrangko dake papko dakmanaha.
Unigimin chinga Isolni ka'sa- chakaniko bienga.
Bilaksrangbegipa Isol, chingna ka'sachake chingni pilak paprangko kema ka'bo.
Pilak namgijaoniko chingko jokatbo.
Nama kamko ka'na gisikni bilko bilakatbo aro chingko jringjrotni janggiona rimangbo.
Chingni Gitel Jisu Kristochi ia bi'ako chu'sokatpabo.
Amen.

(Pamong dongode, ka'mao segimin Pap wataniko agan- prakgen ) PAP WATANI Bilaksrangbegipa ka'saan gapgipa Isol, na'simangni pilak paprangko kema ka'china aro na'simangna gisik pil'na chol aro Gisik Rongtalgipani bilko patichina.
Amen.
--- Page 8 --- GITELNI BI·ANI O, salgio' donggipa chlngnt Paa.
Nang'ni bimingko rongtala intokchina.
Nang'ni songnok ong'bechina.
gio maikai uandaken a'aoba nang'ni namnika chu'sok- china.
Chingni cha'na nangako da'alo chingna on'bo.
Aro chingna gro nanggiparangko chinga wataha gitan, chingni grorangko watbo.
Aro chingko dakmajoaona rimnapnabe, indiba namgijagipaoniko chingko jokatbo.
Maina songnok, bit aro rasong jringjrotnan nang'n.n ong'a.
Amen.
Pamong :--Gitel chingni ku'sikrangko oatbo.
Jinma :-Chinga nang'ko ring'mitelgen.
P :-O, lsol.
chingko bakbak jokatbo.
J :-O, Gitel, chingna dakchakbo.
(lano pilakan chadenggen.) P :-Pagipa, Dagipa aro Gisik Rongtalgipani rasong ong'- china.
J : --Chengo jekai, uandaken jringjrotnaba.
Amen.
P :-Gitelko mitelbo.
J :--Gitelni bimingna rasong ong'china.

Gitrang  95 Re'babo, an'ching Jihovana ring'na hai; An'chingko jokatani rong'brakna an'ching inchrona hai: Mitela gnang an'ching uni mikkangona re'bana hai : Gitrangchi an'ching una inchrona hai: Aro pilak miterangna bate dal'gipa Raja ong'a: Uni jakon a'ani ning'tugipa biaprang donga : Abrirangni chugipa bakrangba unin ong'a: Sagal unin ong'a, aro uko ua dakaha : Aro uni jakrang a'gako dakaha: Re'babo, an'ching olakina aro tugopna hai; --- Page 9 --- Jihova anchingko Dakgipani mikkango an'ching ja'sku dipanna hai: Maina uan an'chingni lsol ong'a, Aro an'chinga uni cha'amramni manderang.
aro uni jakpani mesrang ong'a Da'alo, na'simang uni ku'rangko knaode [namachim]!
Na'simangni ka'tongtangko rakatnabe, Meribao gita; Bakrao Massani salo gita; Jensalo na'simangni pagitchamrang angko dakmajoaha, Angko dake niaha, aro angni kamko nikaha.

Bilsi sotbrina kingking ua chasongko anga mitchinikaha, Aro aganaha, lan ka'tongtangtango branggipa manderang onga, Aro uamang angni ramarangko u'ijaha: Unigimin uamang angni neng'takanio napjawa ine Angri ka'o nangao anga mikchetaha.
Pagipa, Degipa aro Gisik Rongtalgipani rasong ong'china.
Chengo jekai, uandaken jringjrotnaba.
Amen.
SKANGGIPA PORAIANI Gitrang  100 Jinovana inchrobo, pilak na'simang a'songrang.
Ka'sroke Jihovana dangdike on'bo: Ring'ani gnang uni mikkangona re'babo.
Jihovaan Isol ong'a ine na'simang u'ibo: Uan an'chingko dakgipa ong'a, aro an'chinga unin ong'a; An'chinga uni manderang ong'a, aro uni cha'amrangni mesrang.
De'mitela gnang"uni choigugarango, Aro mitela gnang uni sarango napbo: Uko mitelbo aro uni bimingko namchina inbo.
--- Page 10 --- Maina Jihova namgipa ong'a: uni ka'sae .
dakaniara jringjrotnan.
Aro uni bebe dakaniara pilak chasongrangonan ong'a.
Pagipa, Degipa aro Gisik Rongtalgipani rasong ong'china, Chengo jekai, uandaken jringjrotnaba.
Amen.
GNIGIPA PORAIANI (Bebera 'ani Ja'pang (Creed) Salgi aro a'ako Dakgipa bilaksranggipa Pagipa Isoto anga bebera'a.
Aro uni saksakamkam Depante, an'- chingni Gitel Jisu Kristoo.
Jean Gisik Rongtalgipachi oko keako man'aha ; Me'tra Mariamo atchiaha, Pontius Pilatni ning'o duk chakaha.
chisolo su'a man'aha, siaha aro gopaha.
Ua sigiminrangona ong'onangaha, gittam- gipa salo sigiminrangoni chakatpilaha.
Ua salgichi gakatangha, Bilaksranggipa Pagipa Isolni jakrao asong- enga.
Uonin ua tangenggipa aro sigiminrangko bichal ka'na re'bataigen.
Anga Gisik Rongtalgipao, rongtalgipa Katolic Mon- dolio, Rongtalgiparangni nangrimanio, pap watanio, be'en bimangni chakatpilanio aro jringjrotni janggio bebera'a.
Amen.
Pamong :- Gitel na'simang baksa dongchina.
Jinma :--Ua nang ka'tongo dongchina.
P :-Hai an'ching bi'na.
O, Gitel, chingna ka'sachakbo.
O,Kristo, chingna ka'sachakbo.
O, Gitel, chingna ka'sachakbo.
O, salgio donggipa chingni Paa, nang'ni bimingko rongtala ine intokchina, nang'ni songnok ong'bachina.
